name: Lake waterline and bottom (Lake Ray Hubbard, fresh water)
kind: gelcoat band + bottom film (shader math, no new maps)

boats.fleet and berthed boats: scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE, the lake waterline block (IsHull, LP.z = cm above the design waterline)
boats.Sunfish: dry-sailed on a dolly: L0-L2 show nothing, L4 only a faint line (same BOAT_CODE block, scaled by its smaller Wet)

views: heeled 20 degrees, windward side shows the line and the bottom, 3 m

real_size_cm.note: measured from Bean's TX 7295 EC photo with the 3 inch (7.6 cm) Texas registration letters as the scale

level_notes.L0: clean: no line, fresh grey bottom paint
level_notes.L1: a few months: a hairline grey film where the water sits, hard to see beyond 3 m
level_notes.L2: club boat (TX 7295 EC): a thin ragged grey-tan line about 1.6 cm high, the bottom a little greyer below it
level_notes.L3: old but kept: the owner scrubs the line, so it is fainter than L2; fresh bottom paint
level_notes.L4: neglected: a tan-brown clay band 5-8 cm high with olive slime at and below it, blotchy green-grey film over the bottom

wear_inputs: Dirt only (care removes it); Time only darkens the bottom paint slightly. No barnacles or mussel crust: Lake Ray Hubbard is fresh water and only 'suspect' for zebra mussels. The salt-water band and crust (Site bay/Gulf) stay as they are.
budget: no new textures on any tier; a few ALU ops in BOAT_CODE
replaces: BOAT_CODE 'mustache' scum band driven by the livery's wear.y
BOAT_CODE E1 lake stain band driven by age/care (green-brown up to 25 cm on every berthed boat)
J/22 hero scum band (#7F7766, 3-8 cm) and bottom slime
